        start_quat = np.asarray(start_quat, dtype=float)
        goal_quat = np.asarray(goal_quat, dtype=float)
        count = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(goal_pos - start_pos) / max_spacing)))
        for i in range(1, count + 1):

            pos = start_pos + (goal_pos - start_pos) * t
